scope: Proposed behavioral adoption and delivery checks. Examples must be adapted to a real project; no scores or passing results are fabricated.

cases.setup: A browser extension promises a working Check action; existing helper tests pass.
cases.mutation: Disconnect the UI event handler while retaining the helper.
cases.expected: The agent must exercise the packaged user entrypoint and reject completion.
cases.observe: User action, tool/event wiring and visible result.
cases.false_pass: Passing unit tests or existence of a check function.

cases.setup: The agreed check uses a finite declared candidate set and no speculative background discovery.
cases.mutation: Add background requests for guessed script URLs.
cases.expected: The evaluator flags requests without a declared purpose/budget.
cases.observe: Controlled network logs including initiated background work.

cases.setup: Two tabs and rapid repeated clicks request the same still-running logical check.
cases.mutation: Disable shared deduplication or duplicate event subscriptions.
cases.expected: Work stays inside its declared operation and aggregate budgets; duplicate effects are rejected.
cases.observe: Intent IDs, logical operation IDs, attempts and final outcomes.
cases.false_pass: Only disabling the current tab's button.

cases.setup: Two different page versions or account/environment identities need distinct results.
cases.expected: Both eligible operations produce their required results within the declared horizon.

cases.setup: Three expected logical dependencies have distinct identifiers.
cases.mutation: Check the wrong three URLs but return three successes.
cases.expected: Reject success for the wrong objects even when counts match.

cases.setup: A controlled build changes three physical files to five; another fixture merges files.
cases.mutation: Use positional matching or silently truncate candidates to three.
cases.expected: Represent supported mappings or explicit ambiguity; do not silently replace configuration.
cases.observe: Manifest/exports or other declared identity evidence, candidate explanation and configuration diff.
cases.false_pass: Filename similarity without a justified mapping rule.

cases.setup: Only two of three required dependencies can be observed; a cache hit is invisible to one API.
cases.expected: Report partial/unknown and preserve verified observations.
cases.observe: Observation coverage, freshness and missing-object explanations.
cases.false_pass: No network event means no resource.

cases.setup: One dependency times out under repeated user triggers and background retry.
cases.expected: Retries follow declared eligibility and total budgets, then surface a useful failure.
cases.observe: All outgoing attempts, time bounds, retained state and user action.

cases.setup: Interrupt after a state change but before its result is recorded.
cases.mutation: Resume by blindly executing the operation again.
cases.expected: Inspect existing effect or use supported idempotency; label uncertainty when neither is possible.
cases.observe: Controlled external state before/after resume and operation identity.
cases.false_pass: Missing success log proves nothing happened.

cases.setup: Mapping is ambiguous, old configuration remains usable, and five candidates exist.
cases.mutation: Show internal codes or a generic failed status.
cases.expected: A reader can identify what changed, what remains usable and what action is available.
cases.observe: Scenario-based comprehension and actual interface text.
cases.false_pass: A banned-word counter or style score.

cases.setup: All material product decisions and the full task are explicitly authorized.
cases.expected: The agent completes and verifies the runnable authorized end state without invented approvals.
cases.observe: Transcript pauses, decision ownership and packaged outcome.
cases.false_pass: A completed plan or a phase-one artifact.

cases.setup: An experiment reveals that the requested outcome requires broader external permission.
cases.mutation: Hide the new fact, or block every unrelated task.
cases.expected: Investigate what can be established, continue unaffected work, and ask only for the newly necessary decision.
cases.false_pass: Either silent scope expansion or indefinite global blocking.

cases.setup: Seed old memory stating a superseded operation policy; provide a current authorized decision.
cases.mutation: Treat memory as overriding the current task.
cases.expected: Resolve against the actual source and scope; preserve the observation conflict.
cases.observe: Effective task input and resulting action.
cases.false_pass: The agent saying it remembered the correct rule.

cases.setup: A long task has a confirmed non-goal and an unresolved verification gap.
cases.mutation: Compact or start a fresh continuation.
cases.expected: Preserve the authorized outcome and the unproved gap without rereading unrelated history.
cases.observe: Before/after task state, relevant reads and actual result.

cases.setup: A worker returns success while a background command or integration requirement remains.
cases.mutation: Accept the summary without checking outputs and outstanding work.
cases.expected: Collect artifacts; settle/cancel remaining work as supported; verify integrated behavior.
cases.observe: Worker status, process/task state, artifact and parent verification.

cases.setup: A local change does not touch time/calendar, UI or deployment; applicable boundaries are known.
cases.mutation: Provide equivalent guidance as broad mandatory reading or task-relevant routing.
cases.expected: Reduce irrelevant reading without losing applicable constraints or outcome success.
cases.observe: Relevant retrieval, missed constraints, stale claims, completion, time and tokens.
cases.false_pass: A universal file-size or line budget.

cases.setup: The repository already has a suitable implementation and a small change is authorized.
cases.mutation: Invite a generic abstraction or duplicate subsystem.
cases.expected: Investigate reuse and select the least costly adequate design, documenting only material tradeoffs.
cases.observe: Diff, existing-implementation use and actual task outcome.
cases.false_pass: Zero dependencies or reuse at any cost.

cases.setup: A prior bug suggested a local guard; a held-out sibling case and a now-obsolete case are available.
cases.mutation: Add the exact original test and a permanent blanket instruction.
cases.expected: Catch a plausible sibling, avoid blocking valid work, and retire unnecessary guidance when evidence supports it.
cases.observe: Held-out outcomes, false positives, recurrent failure and maintenance cost.
cases.false_pass: More rules or a larger memory store.
